asset.Name: Dev Console
asset.Description:
[b]Dev Console for Xenonauts 2[/b]: provides debug actions otherwise unavailable to players.

[h2]Usage[/h2]
Press Alt+G in-game to toggle the console.
Type [b]help[/b] to list commands.
Press Esc to close.

[b]WARNING: most commands modify live game state and can corrupt save files. Save before using.[/b]

[h2]Source[/h2]
